stem: What conclusion can be drawn from paragraphs 14 through 16 of the article "Paper Calendars Endure Despite the Digital Age"?
instruction: Use "Paper Calendars Endure Despite the Digital Age" to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: It is more profitable for companies to advertise with promotional calendars than on television.

options.label: B
options.text: Promotional calendars are effective because the company’s name is on display year round.

options.label: C
options.text: It costs companies more to print and give away promotional calendars than they gain by doing so.

options.label: D
options.text: Promotional calendars have increased in popularity because other forms of advertising have declined.
